0.DetailedText: You get a {{Tokens}} token box every month. Due to platform restrictions, you must log in each week in order to claim this reward. If you want to claim this reward on another platform you can, but you must login at least once a month on the platform you became a member on.

PlatformSpecificDetailedTexts.3: You get a {{Tokens}} token box every month. You must log in at least once during each 30 day period in order to claim this reward.

0.TitleText: {{Tokens}} bonus tokens per month ($11 USD in monthly value)

1.DetailedText: You get a box containing a random 4-star item every week. If you have all 4-star items you will get a 800 token box instead. The week resets at 12 AM UTC on Sundays. Due to platform restrictions, you must login each week in order to claim this reward. If you want to claim this reward on another platform you can, but you must login at least once a month on the platform you became a member on.

13.DetailedText: Unlock the ability to turn earned tokens into real-world money
13.ShortText: Unlock the ability to turn earned tokens into real-world money
13.TitleText: Unlock the ability to turn earned tokens into real-world money

14.DetailedText: Get {{Tokens}} every month and a {{RRODiscount}}% discount on eligible items
14.ShortText: Get {{Tokens}} every month and a {{RRODiscount}}% discount on eligible items

2.DetailedText: You get {{RRODiscount}}% off all purchases in Rec Room Original token stores (e.g. the watch, merch booth, mirror, cafe, paintball, etc). This does not include Rec Room Original stores that don’t use tokens (e.g. Laser Tag, Lost Skulls, and Crescendo)
2.TitleText: {{RRODiscount}}% discount in Rec Room stores that accept tokens

3.DetailedText: You get early access to items for a limited time and can claim them for free by logging in while they are in early access.
3.ShortText: Free, early access to items for a limited time!
3.TitleText: Free, early access to items for a limited time

4.DetailedText: You get {{MemberOutfitSlots}} outfit slots on top of the regular {{NonMemberOutfitSlots}}. Access them via the Saved Outfits button in the Profile section of your watch or on your Dorm room mirror.

5.DetailedText: You can sell inventions and custom clothing in the watch store and keys, currencies, and consumables in your rooms. You will be paid 70% of all tokens earned through these sales. Those tokens will be held for a week in an escrow account to mitigate fraud, then they’ll be delivered to you the same day as your other RR+ bonus tokens.

6.DetailedText: Whenever you are offered tokens from a post-activity or first activity of the day reward, you will be offered twice the normal amount.

7.DetailedText: You can create your own custom shirts with the clothing customizer! You can access the clothing customizer in your backpack, and publish shirts which can be purchased and worn.

9.DetailedText: Keep saving {{RRODiscount}}% on every RRO order!

HighlightText: The best deal in Rec Room!

StringConfigs.RRPlusMessageBody: Thanks for becoming a RR+ member. You now have access to all the member benefits!
